title: Home practical guide and safety card: rust jars
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Reactivity (9F); energy transfer by heating
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 30 (Home practical guide and safety card: rust jars (portal worksheet; adult boils water, label jars))
intro: Lesson 30: Rusting: what iron needs. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out what iron needs to rust
equipment: Tap water, boiled water (adult boils), oil
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Jar A: nail in tap water (air and water)
Jar B: nail in cooled boiled water with oil on top (water, no air)
Jar C: nail in a dry jar with a lid (air, no water)
Keep the same type of nail, time and temperature
Leave for a week; check every two days
Record and conclude what iron needs

questions.q: Big question: why do some ships rust faster?
questions.a: Salt water, damaged paint and no protection speed up rusting.
